notes: Captured from the live Launch Library 2 API (launches/upcoming, limit=50, mode=normal) and trimmed to the first 45 launches. To stay within the size budget, image/infographic/logo/program/agency sub-objects and long location descriptions were removed; every field the adapter reads is as captured. `next` was set to null. Launch times lie after the fixture epoch by nature (these are scheduled launches); last_updated values are all earlier than the epoch. The malformed variant is hand-authored.
